docs.title: Galaxy‑SynBioCAD Tutorials
docs.text:
Welcome! This mini-site gathers three example tutorials. Replace the content with your tutorials or copy/paste from the Galaxy Training Material.

Before starting
  • Create an account on your Galaxy instance
  • Check that you have the example datasets available
  • Consult the Prerequisites section in each tutorial

docs.text:

Source of inspiration: Galaxy Training Material.

docs.title: About
docs.text:
This site is generated with MkDocs and the Material for MkDocs theme.

  • Edit the Markdown pages in the docs/ folder
  • Preview locally:
pip install mkdocs-material
mkdocs serve
  • Deployment: a GitHub Actions workflow automatically publishes to the gh-pages branch.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
Context

Galaxy‑SynBioCAD provides workflows for synthetic biology (retrosynthesis, pathway design, etc.).

Dependencies (click to expand)
  • Active Galaxy account
  • Example data downloaded
  • Up-to-date browser

docs.title: Quick Steps
docs.text:
1. Open the RetroPath2 workflow in Galaxy
  2. Choose the chemical target and starting stock
  3. Launch execution and analyze results

docs.title: Useful Commands
docs.text:
Linux / macOSWindows (PowerShell) 
conda activate synbiocad

conda activate synbiocad
